- Lung opacities were noted in one instance as scattered and potentially related to scarring or interstitial changes.
- Heart size was consistently described as normal or borderline across all retrieved records, with no definitive cardiomegaly.
- No evidence of pleural effusion, suspicious lung nodules, atelectasis, or acute fractures was found in any of the reports.
- The majority of the reports indicate no acute cardiopulmonary abnormalities and clear lung fields.
